label: Whatever is CONTAINED_IN_1 a bearer without being a real constituent of it is apprehended by it
paraphrase: OPEN conceptualist premise about non-real being, analyst formulation, attribution deferred (related to the classical dictum that beings of reason have being only in an intellect; Augustine, Leibniz and Plantinga are navigation only): for every bearer b and item e, if e is contained in b (CONTAINED_IN_1) and is not a real constituent of b, then b itself apprehends e. It is general: it mentions no favouring, value or root. It entails that a bearer that apprehends nothing contains no non-real item. It is not a consequence of the dictum: it drops the dependence modality (weaker) but indexes apprehension to the bearer that contains the item (stronger, since the dictum allows apprehension by some other intellect), and it ranges over every non-real contained item rather than over beings of reason, so the dictum reaches A4's modes only if every non-real item is a being of reason, which A4 denies. Warrant for the dictum bears at most on apprehension by some apprehender; a dictum-faithful sibling would need a root bridge that nothing other than the root can apprehend an item contained in it before production, which is not registered. Its negation says only that some bearer contains a non-real item that it does not apprehend; the item may still be apprehended by, or depend for its being on, another intellect (an intermediate denier). Mind-independence is an additional commitment of the noncognitive imitability-exemplar rival (A4: the modes of imitability of a simple nature) and of a Scotist reading (formalities distinguished a parte rei but not really). At a root before production an intermediate denier needs another intellect beside the root to apprehend or ground items in it, which in the analyst's judgment is the independent locus priced at 65805e5a (not typed; see the dictum-faithful sibling in the note). It is strictly stronger than the root cognition criterion given the other premises of its derivation, even restricted to the root route (Comparator companion rootCriterionWithoutConceptualism: a non-real contained stand-in of a non-present candidate at an actual root with a good-general favouring is unapprehended while the root criterion holds). Given those premises, the root criterion is equivalent only to a weakened existential form (Lean-only NonRealStandInYieldsApprehension: some apprehended content about some candidate, not the stand-in itself).
